description: Replace a session's title/description, and optionally REPLACE the entire stored flowSpec (full overwrite — get_asset_flow first). For targeted graph changes prefer add_flow_node, update_flow_node, connect_flow_nodes, or apply_flow_edits.

flowSpec.description: Complete replacement for the stored graph — not a merge. Fetch the current spec with get_asset_flow first.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.
